# [TASK] Create Cloudflare Tunnel Docker Compose and Minikube Kubernetes manifest

## Task
Add Cloudflare Tunnel manifests for local Docker Compose and Minikube Kubernetes setups to forward public HTTPS traffic to the internal API Gateway.

## Parent Story
Parent: #142

## Scope
Includes `infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.tunnel.yml` and `infrastructure/kubernetes/overlays/local/cloudflare-tunnel.yaml`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Docker Compose override `docker-compose.tunnel.yml` provisions `docker.io/cloudflare/cloudflared:latest` pointing to `api-gateway:8080`.
- [x] Kubernetes overlay `cloudflare-tunnel.yaml` provides a deployment pointing to the internal `api-gateway` service in Minikube.
- [x] Validated with Podman and `kubectl validate`.

## Estimate
**Hours:** 3

## Notes
Verified: `infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.tunnel.yml` and `overlays/local/cloudflare-tunnel.yaml`.
